title: Customer refreshes an expired session securely

card.so_that: I stay logged in without re-entering credentials and without weakening security

context: Refresh-token rotation must be atomic and replay-resistant so a stolen or duplicated refresh token cannot mint extra sessions.

then: a new access+refresh pair is issued
the previous refresh token is revoked

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: replayed refresh token revokes the family
given: a refresh token that was already used
then: the entire token family is revoked

given: two simultaneous refresh requests with the same token
then: only one new pair is issued; the other request fails closed
an audit event with {event, actor, ts, outcome, audit_id} is emitted

pii_fields.justification: operates on opaque tokens, not PII

audit_events.justification: refresh and revocation are security events

idempotency.justification: rotation must be atomic so concurrent refreshes cannot double-issue

reversibility.justification: rotation is forward-only; revocation is the safety control

regulatory.justification: no regulated data beyond the credential already covered in AUTH-01
